name: Tahawwur Hussain Rana
real_life_parallel: 26/11 co-conspirator; extradited from US April 2025; closure beat

biography.background: Pakistani-Canadian businessman and former military doctor. 26/11 co-conspirator who provided cover for David Headley's reconnaissance. Convicted in US (2011) but acquitted of direct terrorism charges. Extradited to India April 2025 after years of legal battles.
biography.26_11_role: Provided immigration cover to Headley; allowed use of his Chicago-based immigration business as front
biography.extradition: April 2025 — after Trump administration pressure; arrived Delhi; NIA custody
biography.film_relevance: Part 4: Extradition as closure beat; ties back to Part 1's 26/11; justice delayed but delivered
